name: Perseverance Rover & Ingenuity
highlight: Collected 25+ hermetically sealed rock cores; Ingenuity flew 72 times across Jezero.

name: Curiosity Rover (MSL)
highlight: Traversed >32 km climbing Mount Sharp; confirmed past long-lived habitable freshwater lake.

name: Zhurong Rover (Tianwen-1)
highlight: First Chinese rover on Mars; detected shallow underground sedimentary layers with subsurface radar.

name: InSight Lander
highlight: Detected 1,300+ marsquakes, measured Martian crust thickness (24–72 km) and liquid core size.

name: Opportunity Rover (MER-B)
highlight: Traversed 45.16 km over 14.5 years; discovered hematite 'blueberries' proving past water.

name: Spirit Rover (MER-A)
highlight: Traversed 7.73 km; uncovered 90% pure opaline silica proving ancient volcanic hot spring activity.

name: Phoenix Mars Lander
highlight: First to touch and taste Martian water ice beneath the soil surface near the North Pole.

name: Pathfinder & Sojourner
highlight: First wheeled rover on Mars (Sojourner); analyzed flood gravels and boulders.

name: Viking 1 Lander
highlight: First operational spacecraft to send color photographs from the surface of Mars.

name: Viking 2 Lander
highlight: Photographed boulder-strewn volcanic plains and detected thin seasonal water-ice frost.

name: Mars 3 Lander
highlight: First soft landing on Mars during a historic global dust storm; transmitted for 14.5 seconds.

name: Beagle 2 Lander
highlight: Landed successfully in 2003; imaged on surface by MRO in 2015 showing solar panels deployed.
